svg.desc: Seven-phase governed video production ComfyUI workflow for Medium-Large Production. It shows greenlight, pre-production, production, post, release review, distribution, post-launch learning, quality gates, typed artifacts, principal agents, targeted rework, and fail-closed runtime status.

g.text: Video Scale S4 · Medium-Large Production ComfyUI Workflow
Shared seven-phase ComfyUI node graph · one node per agent · sockets · spline handoffs
FAIL-CLOSED — This workflow is a capability/scheduling design. It does not activate network, tools, providers or production without separate host and human gates.
Scale is selected before archetype. Typed handoffs carry correlation, evidence, quality, rights and HiTL state.
